title: Linking ideas: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: I didn't go to the party ___ I was tired.
She is very nice, ___ she is a bit shy.

items.statement: It was cold, so I wore a coat.

items.explanationEs: Verbo + objeto juntos: He drives his car fast.

answers: I usually read the news in the morning.
items.explanationEs: Usually antes del verbo; el momento al final.

items.text: Do you want to stay here ___ go out?
I studied a lot, ___ I passed the exam.

items.sentence: I go every day to the gym.
items.wrong: go every day to the gym
answers: go to the gym every day
items.explanationEs: Primero el lugar (to the gym), después el tiempo (every day).
